Holsgrove hungry for Scotland chance - gossip
- Published
Portugal-based midfielder retains Scotland dream as Hibs manager talks of strong bond with Hearts goalkeeper...
Jordan Holsgrove remains determined to earn a Scotland place and there has been recent communication between the 27-year-old Estoril midfielder and the national team set-up. (The Herald - subscription required, external)
Hibernian boss Marink Reedijk admits he's looking forward to a reunion with his former Beveren goalkeeper Beau Reus but insists he will "love him a bit less" during Sunday's Premier Sports Cup semi-final against Hearts at Hampden. (Edinburgh Evening News, external)
Josh Campbell explains that he is still getting up to speed at St Johnstone after a period of illness, having netted his first goal for the club as a substitute in Wednesday's draw with Motherwell. (The Herald - subscription required, external)
Another top-six finish "has to be the goal" for Falkirk, insists Ben Krauhaus, who scored away to Aberdeen to make it three wins in a row for John McGlynn's side. (Falkirk Herald, external)
Aberdeen may be low on confidence but must "fight with all they've got" in Saturday's Premier Sports Cup semi-final against Rangers, says club hero Joe Harper, who is backing "experienced campaigner" Nicky Devlin to handle the occasion if the 33-year-old has to start at Hampden. (Press & Journal - subscription required, external)
Manager Tony Mowbray reveals Blackburn Rovers were looking "pretty hard" at signing Elijah Just before the New Zealand midfielder moved from Motherwell to Swansea City this summer. (The72, external)
